newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt bourse, DTB closed on Thursday, IBIS open.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt bourse, DTB closed on Thursday, IBIS open.

text.p: Bourse trade in Frankfurt will be closed on Thursday for the Corpus Christi regional holiday, as will the DTB futures and options exchange, the German bourse operating group Deutsche Boerse said.
However, IBIS electronic bourse trade will take place as normal, Deutsche Boerse said. As it is an electronic trading system, it is not based in any particular centre.
Corpus Christi is a market and public holiday in the German states of Baden-Wuerttemberg, Bavaria, Hesse, North Rhine-Westphalia, Rhineland Palatinate, Saarland, Saxony (partly), Thuringia.
